name: omp-advisor-consensus
description: Adversarial advisor convergence loop: reprompt and steer the agent on advisor findings until both agree and every item is closed

omp.description: Turn unanswered advisor findings into a bounded adversarial loop: reprompt the agent, re-review, repeat until the advisor is silent and the agent claims closure

enabled.description: Arm the convergence loop. Off by default; arm per session with /adversarial on or durably with `omp plugin config --set enabled=true`.

minSeverity.description: Lowest advisor finding severity that keeps the loop running.

maxRounds.description: Continuation turns this plugin may spend on one user prompt.

maxRepeats.description: Times the advisor may re-raise the same finding before the loop escalates to the operator.

forceSyncBacklog.description: Pin advisor.syncBacklog to strict while the loop is armed, so an empty review really means agreement.

useSessionModel.description: Default the advisor's model to the session's live model instead of the advisor role's slow chain. An explicitly configured modelRoles.advisor or WATCHDOG model still wins.

requireStopCall.description: Strict agreement: only an explicit advise(note: "[converged] ...") closes the loop. With this on, advisor silence escalates instead of converging — pair it with WATCHDOG.md that tells the advisor to call stop.

notify.description: Toast each round, convergence, and escalation.
